purpose: Stage measured map-density, transit-motion, and interaction pressure into runtime-state-v1 so LeeWay can later select bounded rendering and acquisition policies without modifying the canonical Formula.
questions: How dense is the visible spatial context right now?
How many source-backed moving subjects require continuous interpolation?
How far do transit GPS fixes deviate from an exact known route geometry?
How much label/candidate work is visible versus culled by zoom and collision rules?
What frame-time and interaction-latency pressure is the current presentation causing?
What memory/GPU pressure is attributable to currently active map surfaces?

dimensions.definition: source-backed POI, transit, aircraft, CCTV and other candidates admitted into the current viewport before final collision culling
subjects currently requiring continuous interpolation or animation rather than static request-render updates
measured distance from a transit GPS fix to the exact matching mapped/published route geometry when that route identity is known
labels actually painted after zoom, priority, and collision admission
measured rendered-frame duration over the observation window
measured time from a user gesture to the corresponding visible or state response

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive observations under the same app version, device policy, viewport class and enabled-layer identity

rules: POI labels use zoom-tier admission and bounded provider results.
Transit vehicles use exact-route constrained display geometry only when route identity and geometry match; otherwise raw source GPS remains visible without pretending it is snapped.
Continuous rendering is held only while visible motion exists.
Secondary cockpit rendering is on-demand and releases its GPU context when closed.
CCTV projection/coverage geometry stays off by default in Personal Maps until explicitly requested.

prohibitions: Do not use Formula to invent business locations, transit routes, GPS fixes, CCTV frames, or provider availability.
Do not snap a transit vehicle to an unrelated route merely because it is nearby.
Do not promote mapped or scheduled evidence to LIVE.
Do not execute Formula until calibrated ranges, replay traces, and ablation against the deterministic baseline exist.
Do not discard canonical provider evidence after creating a condensed LeeWay operational state.

canonicalEvidenceRule.preserve: Original provider evidence and timestamps remain authoritative and auditable.
canonicalEvidenceRule.condense: LeeWay may derive compact operational state for rendering, prioritization and continuity, but every derived state must retain source/provenance linkage.

veritasAcceptance: The same source trace and device policy reproduce the same staged observations.
Route-constrained transit presentation never changes the stored raw GPS evidence.
POI density never causes all-world business records to be materialized in the browser at once.
Formula-selected policies must beat or equal deterministic baseline frame time and interaction latency without reducing truth fidelity.
Canonical Formula and runtime-state adapter hashes match authority pins.
reason: Spatial-density mapping is staged only. Calibration traces and controlled Formula-versus-baseline comparisons do not yet exist.
